description: The Life of a Showgirl?? This is NOT the Taylor I signed up for, bestie 😒💅 She really said 'let me drop some random pop era no one asked for' and I'm sitting here confused. 'Elizabeth Taylor' and 'Opalite' are kinda cute but the rest is giving filler 💤✨ I wanted the lore and I got... this. It's fine I guess, but don't call it her best era because I WILL argue.
